name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
description: Canonical app origin for links, QR redirects, Stripe return URLs, and local development.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
description: Public Supabase project URL used by browser and server clients.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
description: Supabase anon key safe for browser usage with Row Level Security.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
description: Stripe publishable key used by client-side Stripe flows.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY
description: Optional PostHog project key for product analytics capture.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST
description: Optional PostHog host, for example https://app.posthog.com or a regional endpoint.

name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
description: Privileged Supabase service-role key for trusted server-side jobs only.

name: SUPABASE_DB_URL
description: Optional Postgres connection URL used only for applying migrations, seeding fixtures, and running SQL RLS tests.

name: SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD
description: Optional database password used with linked Supabase pooler metadata when SUPABASE_DB_URL is not set.

name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
description: Stripe secret key for server-side billing and portal calls.

name: STRIPE_GROWTH_PRICE_ID
description: Stripe recurring Price ID for the Growth Plan at GBP 29/month.

name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
description: Stripe webhook signing secret used to verify webhook requests.

name: RESEND_API_KEY
description: Resend API key for transactional email from trusted server code.

name: RESEND_FROM
description: Verified Resend sender for Supabase Send Email auth hook messages, e.g. 'Nabaperks <login@your-domain>'. Used for merchant/admin email auth.

name: TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID
description: Twilio Account SID used by customer Twilio Verify phone OTPs and any legacy Supabase SMS hook usage.

name: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN
description: Optional Twilio Auth Token used by direct customer Twilio Verify API calls. If omitted, TWILIO_API_KEY_SID and TWILIO_API_KEY_SECRET are required.

name: TWILIO_VERIFY_SERVICE_SID
description: Twilio Verify Service SID used for customer phone OTP start/check flows.

name: CUSTOMER_SESSION_SECRET
description: High-entropy secret for signing first-party customer pending-phone and 30-day session cookies.

name: CUSTOMER_PHONE_HMAC_SECRET
description: High-entropy secret for deterministic HMAC lookup of verified customer phone numbers.

name: CUSTOMER_PHONE_ENCRYPTION_KEY
description: High-entropy key material used to derive AES-GCM encryption keys for stored customer phone ciphertext.

name: TWILIO_API_KEY_SID
description: Twilio API key SID for customer Twilio Verify OTPs when TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN is not set, and for legacy Supabase Send SMS hook usage.

name: TWILIO_API_KEY_SECRET
description: Twilio API key secret for customer Twilio Verify OTPs when TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN is not set, and for legacy Supabase Send SMS hook usage.

name: TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID
description: Legacy Twilio Messaging Service SID for the Supabase Send SMS auth hook. Not used by customer OTP.

name: SUPABASE_SEND_EMAIL_HOOK_SECRET
description: Standard Webhooks signing secret (v1,whsec_...) for the Supabase send-email auth hook. Must match the secret configured in the Supabase dashboard.

name: SUPABASE_SEND_SMS_HOOK_SECRET
description: Legacy Standard Webhooks signing secret for the Supabase Send SMS auth hook. Customer OTP does not use this hook.
